metadata.description: Marketplace for the Elite Credit AI plugin — credit-journey suite (repair / optimization / maintenance + financial education) for US consumers (Latino focus). Bilingual ES/EN intake, deep audit of tri-bureau credit reports, triple-output deliverables (technical forensic report + plain-language consumer summary + interactive HTML dashboard with PDF export), and a personalized post-audit interview that enriches dispute letters with the user's own narrative and evidence.

plugins.name: elite-credit-ai
plugins.description: Credit-journey suite for the full arc: forensic repair, score optimization, and maintenance + financial education. Bilingual ES/EN intake with multi-select goals and an 'analyze my report for me' option for users who don't know how to read their report. Audit of tri-bureau PDFs with cross-bureau and temporal detection. Triple output per audit: technical forensic report (.md) for credit-repair pros + plain-language consumer summary (.md) + interactive single-file HTML dashboard rendered inline as an artifact (with one-click PDF export printing a dedicated report layout). Post-audit interactive Q&A captures the user's account-by-account narrative for personalized dispute letters. Strict copy hygiene: no internal mechanics surfaced to the user. 17 dispute-letter templates spanning FCRA, FDCPA, Reg F, plus 5 state-law overlays (CA, TX, NY, FL, others).
